description: MO-CBS solves multi-agent path finding when every move and wait costs a vector of several objectives, such as time and risk. It returns the *Pareto-optimal front*: one plan for each cost vector that no other plan beats in every objective. It extends CBS: the low level returns all Pareto-optimal paths of one agent under its constraints (with BOA* or NAMOA*dr), the roots are all combinations of the agents' Pareto-optimal paths, and a split makes one child for each Pareto-optimal path of the constrained agent. The high level pops nodes in lexicographic cost order and drops each node whose cost a found solution *weakly dominates* (is at least as good in every objective). When the open list is empty, the found set is the exact front; the tree-by-tree form MO-CBS-t, the default, builds the roots one at a time.

papers.authors: Zhongqiang Ren, Sivakumar Rathinam, Howie Choset
papers.title: A Conflict-Based Search Framework for Multi-Objective Multi-Agent Path Finding
